# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For Android runs in this workspace, use the Android Studio1 folder/tooling when available.
- Do not compile Android during changes related to the MAUI project.

## MAUI Project UI Guidelines
- Move Open Folder to a three-dots menu in the top-right.
- Remove Previous/Next buttons and use left/right arrow overlays on the main image viewer.
- Support left/right keyboard shortcuts on Windows.
- Fit the main image viewer to the available viewer size.
- Optimize thumbnails and the main image viewer with background caching similar to the WinForms app.
